title: Tiny, cute submarine
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Water glow around submarine -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='42' ry='16' fill='#1a4a6b' opacity='0.4'/>
  
  <!-- Submarine body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='16' fill='#f5c842'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='26' ry='10' fill='#ffda66'/>
  
  <!-- Porthole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='8' fill='#2a6b8a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='6' fill='#4fc3e8'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#b0eaff'/>
  
  <!-- Front porthole -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='56' r='5' fill='#2a6b8a'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='56' r='3.5' fill='#4fc3e8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#b0eaff'/>
  
  <!-- Periscope -->
  <rect x='40' y='36' width='4' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#d4a017'/>
  <rect x='36' y='33' width='12' height='5' rx='2' fill='#e8b830'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#4fc3e8'/>
  
  <!-- Propeller -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='58' r='7' fill='#7a8b9e'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='54' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#a0b0c4'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='62' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#a0b0c4'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#c0d0e0'/>
  
  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <polygon points='22,46 14,42 14,50' fill='#d4a017'/>
  <polygon points='22,70 14,74 14,66' fill='#d4a017'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom fin -->
  <polygon points='42,72 50,80 58,72' fill='#d4a017'/>
  
  <!-- Bubbles -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='45' r='3' fill='#7ce0ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='38' r='2' fill='#7ce0ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#7ce0ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Cute little smile -->
  <path d='M45,60 Q50,65 55,60' stroke='#c47a10' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Eyebrows on porthole -->
  <path d='M46,49 L48,47' stroke='#c47a10' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54,49 L52,47' stroke='#c47a10' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
